name: tadabur-whisper-medium
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2026-04-05. CAVEAT: card prints base numbers on 1,500 clips per split while its own per-split table uses the full splits (10,509 / 8,142 / 231 clips), with identical undiacritized normalization stated for both. The Quran is a closed 6,236-ayah corpus, so only the unseen-surahs rows are out-of-domain evidence; the 0.67% unseen-reciters row is decoder prior on text the model has seen and the card says so. v1 of this model was evaluated on a split drawn from its own training shard and should not be compared to these rows. FLOPs per active token set to 1.538e+09 (= 2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) rather than the generator's 6e9 coefficient, which is a 3x overstatement still live in tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251; value overwritten from base record whisper-medium.
